context: Evaluates whether the agent runs the full design-debate flow correctly on a multi-file, downstream-consumer decision: precise framing, grounding, identical briefs, opposing roles including Migration/Risk, parallel spawn, synthesized verdict, schema validation, explicit persistence, and handoff.

checklist.name: Precise decision framing
checklist.description: Decision restated as an explicit A-vs-B choice before roles are assigned

checklist.name: Grounding before positions
checklist.description: Concrete investigation (call sites, size, blast radius) performed before the debate starts

checklist.name: Identical brief
checklist.description: All reviewers receive the same decision and the same grounding facts

checklist.name: Opposing roles assigned
checklist.description: Advocate and Skeptic assigned with genuinely opposing stances, not neutral framing

checklist.name: Migration/Risk role included
checklist.description: Migration/Risk role added because the change touches multiple files and a downstream consumer

checklist.name: Parallel spawn
checklist.description: All reviewers spawned in a single message/batch rather than sequentially

checklist.name: Synthesized verdict
checklist.description: A verdict names which argument held up and picks one of proceed/do_not_proceed_for_now/proceed_with_modification

checklist.name: No raw opinion dump
checklist.description: Reviewer output is not presented as the final answer without synthesis

checklist.name: Schema validation run
checklist.description: The verdict is checked against the debate-verdict schema before being treated as final

checklist.name: Explicit persistence ask
checklist.description: The agent asks the user explicitly before persisting the outcome

checklist.name: Correct artifact + handoff
checklist.description: Outcome recorded as finding/known-issue per verdict, and a proceed verdict hands off to plan-create with facts carried forward
